home.faq1Q: What types of courses are available on Coach Space?
home.faq1A: We offer a wide range of courses in Technology, Business, Design, and Personal Growth.
home.faq2Q: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
home.faq2A: Yes! You will receive a recognized certificate of completion that you can share on LinkedIn or add to your resume.
home.faq3Q: How can I start as an instructor?
home.faq3A: You can apply through our 'Become an Instructor' page. Once approved, you can create and publish your courses.
home.faq4A: Yes, our platform is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices, tablets, and desktops.

home.instructorFaqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about teaching, approval, and payouts
home.instructorFaqQ1: How and when are course earnings paid out?
home.instructorFaqA1: Earnings are disbursed on the 1st of each month via direct bank transfer or verified payout gateways.
home.instructorFaqQ2: What quality standards are required for new courses?
home.instructorFaqA2: Minimum 1080p video, crisp noise-free audio, and a structured curriculum with clear learning milestones.
home.instructorFaqQ3: Who retains intellectual property rights to course content?
home.instructorFaqA3: You retain 100% full intellectual property ownership of your content; the platform only hosts and distributes it to enrolled students.
